title: Start a branch from a clean tree
run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- . ':!.swarm')" ]; then
  echo "this folder has uncommitted changes; commit or stash them first:" >&2
  git status --short -- . ':!.swarm' >&2
  exit 1
fi
base=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
[ "$base" != HEAD ] || { echo "check out a branch first" >&2; exit 1; }
branch=swarm/{{run_id}}
git switch -q -c "$branch"
printf '{"branch": "%s", "base": "%s", "summary": "%s from %s"}\n' "$branch" "$base" "$branch" "$base"
